arxiv-2302-02137.title: FedSpectral+: Spectral Clustering using Federated Learning
arxiv-2302-02137.creator: Janvi Thakkar*, Devvrat Joshi*
arxiv-2302-02137.description: Abstract Clustering in graphs has been a well-known research problem, particularly because most Internet and social network data is in the form of graphs. Organizations widely use spectral clustering algorithms to find clustering in graph datasets. However, applying spectral clustering to a large dataset is challenging due to computational overhead.

arxiv-2305-07793.title: Control of ternary alloy composition during remote epitaxy on graphene
arxiv-2305-07793.creator: Zachary LaDuca, Katherine Su, Sebastian Manzo, Michael S. Arnold, Jason K. Kawasaki
arxiv-2305-07793.description: Abstract Understanding the sticking coefficient σ \sigma , i.e., the probability of an adatom sticking to a surface, is essential for controlling the stoichiometry during epitaxial film growth. However, σ \sigma on monolayer graphene-covered surfaces and its impact on remote epitaxy are not understood.

arxiv-2310-00343.title: Application of Deep Learning Methods Combined with Physical Background in Wide Field of View Imaging Atmospheric Cherenkov Telescopes
arxiv-2310-00343.creator: Ao-Yan Cheng, Hao Cai, Shi Chen, Tian-Lu Chen, Xiang Dong, You-Liang Feng, Qi Gao, Quan-Bu Gou, Yi-Qing Guo, Hong-Bo Hu, Ming-Ming Kang, Hai-Jin Li, Chen Liu, Mao-Yuan Liu, Wei Liu, Fang-Sheng Min, Chu-Cheng Pan, Bing-Qiang Qiao, Xiang-Li Qian, Hui-Ying Sun, Yu-Chang Sun, Ao-Bo Wang, Xu Wang, Zhen W
arxiv-2310-00343.description: Abstract The HADAR experiment, which will be constructed in Tibet, China, combines the wide-angle advantages of traditional EAS array detectors with the high sensitivity advantages of focused Cherenkov detectors. Its physics objective is to observe transient sources such as gamma-ray bursts and counterparts of gravitational waves.

arxiv-2405-17355.title: Large-scale time-multiplexed nanophotonic parametric oscillators
arxiv-2405-17355.creator: Robert M. Gray, Ryoto Sekine, Luis Ledezma, Gordon H. Y. Li, Selina Zhou, Arkadev Roy, Midya Parto, Alireza Marandi
arxiv-2405-17355.description: Abstract Arrays of nonlinear resonators offer a fertile ground for a wide range of complex phenomena and opportunities for advanced photonic sensing and computing. Recently, significant attention has focused on studying coupled resonators in special-purpose configurations either on chips or in table-top experiments.

arxiv-2407-08201.title: Masses of Sunyaev-Zel’dovich Galaxy Clusters Detected by The Atacama Cosmology Telescope: Stacked Lensing Measurements with Subaru HSC Year 3 data
arxiv-2407-08201.creator: Masato Shirasaki, Cristóbal Sifón, Hironao Miyatake, Erwin Lau, Zhuowen Zhang, Neta Bahcall, Nicholas Battaglia, Mark Devlin, Jo Dunkley, Arya Farahi, Matt Hilton, Yen-Ting Lin, Daisuke Nagai, Suzanne T. Staggs, Tomomi Sunayama, David Spergel, Edward J. Wollack
arxiv-2407-08201.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Masato Shirasaki, Cristóbal Sifón, Hironao Miyatake, Erwin Lau, Zhuowen Zhang, Neta Bahcall, Nicholas Battaglia, Mark Devlin, Jo Dunkley, Arya Farahi, Matt Hilton, Yen-Ting Lin, Daisuke Nagai, Suzanne T. Staggs, Tomomi Sunayama, David Spergel, Edward J. Wollack. We present a stacked lensing analysis of 96 galaxy clusters selected by the thermal Sunyaev-Zel’dovich (SZ) effect in maps of the cosmic microwave background (CMB).

arxiv-2408-05766.title: The motive of a variety with cellular resolution of singularities
arxiv-2408-05766.creator: Bruno Stonek
arxiv-2408-05766.description: Abstract . A complex variety X X admits a cellular resolution of singularities if there exists a resolution of singularities X ~ → X \widetilde{X}\to X such that its exceptional locus as well as X ~ \widetilde{X} and the singular locus of X X admit a cellular decomposition.

arxiv-2410-22717.title: Efficient Uniform Negative Edge Weights
arxiv-2410-22717.creator: Lukas Geis, Daniel Allendorf, Thomas Bläsius, Alexander Leonhardt, Ulrich Meyer, Manuel Penschuck, Hung Tran
arxiv-2410-22717.description: Abstract We consider a maximum entropy edge weight model that allows for negative weights. Given a graph G G and possible weights 𝒲 \mathcal{W} typically consisting of positive and negative values, the model selects edge weights w ∈ 𝒲 m w\in\mathcal{W}^{m} uniformly at random from all weights that do not introduce a negative cycle.

arxiv-2507-21568.title: Multi-Hypothesis Distillation of Multilingual Neural Translation Models for Low-Resource Languages DOI: 10.1613/jair.1.xxxxx Volume: 4 6 7
arxiv-2507-21568.creator: Aarón Galiano-Jiménez, Juan Antonio Pérez-Ortiz, Felipe Sánchez-Martínez, Víctor M. Sánchez-Cartagena
arxiv-2507-21568.description: Abstract . This paper explores sequence-level knowledge distillation (KD) of multilingual pre-trained encoder-decoder translation models. We argue that the teacher model’s output distribution holds valuable insights for the student, beyond the approximated mode obtained through beam search (the standard decoding method), and present Multi-Hypothesis Distillation (MHD), a sequence-level KD method that generates multiple translations for each source sentence.

pmc-10736444.title: VISUALIZING AGING EQUITY: CROSS-SECTORAL PARTNERSHIPS TO CREATE MAPPING TOOLS FOR SOCIAL CHANGE
pmc-10736444.creator: Clara Scher, Emily Greenfield, Rodney Harrell
pmc-10736444.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). This symposium will feature ways in which gerontologists are advancing the development of online, interactive mapping tools on aging. Utilizing GIS mapping technology and leveraging cross-sectoral partnerships, the speakers will present case illustrations of efforts to develop aging-focused mapping tools that aggregate data sources at the municipal, state, and national levels to advance a spatial awareness of supports for older adults across diverse communities.

pmc-11328129.title: Transition Metal Mimetic π-Activation by Cationic Bismuth(III) Catalysts for Allylic C–H Functionalization of Olefins Using C=O and C=N Electrophiles
pmc-11328129.creator: Ruihan Wang, Sebastián Martínez, Johannes Schwarzmann, Christopher Z. Zhao, Jacqueline Ramler, Crispin Lichtenberg, Yi-Ming Wang
pmc-11328129.description: The discovery and utilization of main-group element catalysts that behave similarly to transition metal (TM) complexes have become increasingly active areas of investigation in recent years. Here, we report a series of Lewis acidic bismuth(III) complexes that allow for the catalytic allylic C(sp3)–H functionalization of olefins via an organometallic complexation-assisted deprotonation mechanism to generate products containing new C–C bonds.

pmc-12714231.title: Identification of intestinal enteroendocrine cell subtypes and their associated hormones in zebrafish
pmc-12714231.creator: Margaret Morash, Richard G. Kay, Erik J. Soderblom, Grace H. MacLean, Jia Wen, Peyton J. Moore, Colin R. Lickwar, Mujahid Ali Shah, Julia Ganz, Fiona M. Gribble, Frank Reimann, Rodger A. Liddle, John F. Rawls
pmc-12714231.description: Enteroendocrine cells (EECs) are rare sensory cells in the intestinal epithelium that coordinate digestive physiology by secreting a diverse repertoire of peptide hormones. These hormones are the main effectors of EEC function, and their characterization requires direct observation by mass spectrometry due to the specialized protein cleavage and posttranslational modifications that yield their mature forms.
